profile.headline: Web Developer at T. Colin Campbell Center for Nutrition Studies
profile.summary:
I graduated from the University of Texas with a B.S. in Nutritional Sciences (hook ‘em!). I found coding shortly after and was elated to be able to channel my love for science in a totally different and exciting way! Soon after, I received a full scholarship with Out In Tech x Flatiron for Flatiron's Full Stack Software Engineering Immersive program. I am now freelancing through my company, Estes-Garcia Consulting, while actively searching for web dev roles and going through Flatiron's course!

I love building mobile and web apps and just find it so satisfying to see my creations come to life in real time. The problem solver in me loves debugging and the creative in me utilizes a design and responsive first approach. When I'm not coding, you can find me sipping sweet tea while working on my first novel and soaking up some glorious Texas sunshine.

I am always looking for new opportunities and challenges. Contact me at samira.estes.garcia@gmail.com if you are interested in working together. I would also love to connect here on LinkedIn, so shoot me a message and maybe we can talk JavaScript over a hot cup of java!

Skills: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript ES5/6, jQuery, React/Redux, Node, Express, GraphQL, Unit Testing with Jest and Enzyme, Ruby, Ruby on Rails, Sinatra, SQL, CLI, Git/Github, Object-Oriented Programming, APIs, Wordpress CMS, Responsive Web Design, Bootstrap, SEO

company.name: T. Colin Campbell Center for Nutrition Studies

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: As a core member of the tech team at CNS, I create custom post types, page templates, and assist in maintaining the custom theme. Technologies used: Sage9, PHP, Advanced Custom Fields, SCSS

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
Through my role at Estes-Garcia Studios, I build frontend and full stack web apps for clients. I'm a key touch point for clients to discuss project ideas where I capture their goals and problems, and turn them into solutions. 

The current project I'm working on is a customer database. It's an electronic iOS check-in app that populates into a backend database. Languages used: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, jQuery, and SQL

Skills:
• Cultivate relationships with clients and seek out new clients
• Collaborate with the UX/UI design team and participate in research and other design phases

positions.title: Web Development Team Lead
positions.description:
I managed and delegated projects to a team of up to 11 development interns. I was a direct report to the CEO and Head of People and Culture. I coded, created, and managed content pertaining to travel. Under my supervision, I dramatically improved Outings & Adventures' Alexa ranking from over 8 million to under 700,00 in just 5 months by implementing SEO best practices. I also increased the page visitors by 600% and page views by 200% within 1 month. I increased the Web Development team productivity by 50% by creating a project ticketing system whereby team members were able to claim assigned projects and log their project progress. I actively worked to refine content creation standards by improving processes and procedures. Ultimately, I facilitated deals with lucrative clients by consistently producing superior and quality content.

In our virtual environment, I enforced the maintenance of excellent virtual communication via Skype Chat, Email, and Basecamp. I attended up to 5 Skype Video conferences per week with the CEO and Social Media Marketing and Creative Services/Graphic Design supervisors to effectively create content and promote our clients. 

WordPress Skills:
• Install, update, implement, and customize plugins
• Customize and install widgets 
• Created custom posts and themes
• Update the live and staging sites intermittently, restore and back up live site
• Languages used: HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript

positions.title: Data Administration Associate
positions.description:
Assisted the lab manager with lab-testing paperwork for incoming and outgoing patients. Scheduled appointments, answered phone calls, created invoices, and filed electronic and physical paperwork.

Skills:
•	Working knowledge with Quikbooks, CPL/Quest software, and Excel spreadsheets
•	Cultivated experience in customer service and numbers driven results

volunteerExperiences.description:
Assisted drop-in point/drop-in manager to facilitate healthy interactions between youth.
Worked with other volunteers to maintain a safe space for the youth, and work with in-house counseling team to affirm the youths' LGBTQ+ identities.
